rule: A blank is honest. Absent fields carry a reason and are never written as zero. 'kind':'quote' rows are sourced exchange figures; the 'reference' block is descriptive contract structure, NOT a quote.

JSE.note: no free derivatives feed; reference structure only

NSE.data_status: FREE: per-contract MTM, expiry, ISIN and open interest in the daily Derivatives Pricelist PDF
product_families: Equity index futures: NSE 25 (N25I), Mini NSE 25 (25MN), Mini NSE 10 (10MN), NSE Banking Sector (NBSI)
Single stock futures on 15 names (SCOM, EQTY, KCBG, EABL, BATK, ABSA, NCBA, COOP, SCBK, IMHP, BRIT, LBTY, KNRE, KEGN, KPLC)
Options on single stock futures (listed June 2026 on six names)
NSE.expiry_cycle: Quarterly: March, June, September, December. Expiry the third Thursday of the expiry month at 15:00 EAT (previous business day if a holiday).
NSE.settlement_basis: Cash settled through NSE Clear. Daily mark-to-market is the VWAP of traded contracts, or the NSE fair value (spot plus cost of carry) for contracts that did not trade.
NSE.contract_size: Single stock futures: 1,000 shares if the underlying trades below KES 100, else 100 shares. Index futures: 1 index point = KES 100.
NSE.not_free: Live/intraday derivatives tick data and level 1/2 depth: paid NSE data service (dataservices@nse.co.ke)
NSE.caveats: The pricelist lays out open interest against a merged expiry cell; open interest is transcribed exactly where the exchange printed it. Per-contract traded volume is not published, only the market-wide day total.

NGX.data_status: FREE: Listed Derivatives Contracts table (contract, expiry, base/opening/applied close price)
product_families: Index futures on the NGX 30 Index (NGX30 monthly codes)
Index futures on the NGX Pension Index (NGXPENSION monthly codes)
NGX.expiry_cycle: Quarterly (H=Mar, M=Jun, U=Sep, Z=Dec). Listings open on the Monday of the contract quarter; cleared by NG Clearing.
NGX.settlement_basis: Cash settled on the index at expiry; daily applied close price is published.
NGX.contract_size: Reference: NGX index futures are cash-settled on the underlying index; confirm the current multiplier with NGX before publishing a notional.
NGX.not_free: Realtime derivatives feed and reference data: paid NGX Market Data Solutions (X-DataPortal)

EGX.data_status: FREE: public derivatives watch list JSON (closing/settlement price, volume, trades)
product_families: Single stock futures: Commercial International Bank (CIB) and Talaat Moustafa Group (TMG)
EGX.expiry_cycle: Index: 3-month (quarterly) and 6-month contracts, two consecutive contracts listed. Last trading day / expiry is the third Wednesday of the contract month (previous working day if that Wednesday is not a working day).
EGX.settlement_basis: Cash settled (T+1) through a central counterparty (Taswyaat). Each index point = EGP 1. Single stock futures represent 100 underlying shares.
EGX.contract_size: EGX30 index futures: 1 index point = EGP 1. Single stock futures: 100 shares per contract.
EGX.not_free: Order-book depth: EGX watch list returns best bid/ask as a single level, null; no free depth

JSE.data_status: NO FREE DATA. End-of-day derivatives data (settlement, open interest, volume) is PAID via the JSE Information Delivery Portal (IDP) FTP subscription.
product_families: Equity derivatives: FTSE/JSE Top 40 index future (ALSI, R10 per point), Mini Top 40 (ALMI, R1 per point), single stock futures, dividend futures (DIVF), options
Currency derivatives: USD/ZAR and other FX futures
Interest rate / bond derivatives (Yield-X): bond futures, interest-rate futures and swaps
Commodity derivatives (SAFEX agricultural): maize, wheat, sunflower, soybeans
JSE.expiry_cycle: Equity/index: quarterly March, June, September, December; expiry via an intraday closing auction from 12:00 SAST on the third Thursday (previous business day if a holiday). Commodity: own monthly cycle.
JSE.settlement_basis: Index futures cash settled on the auction uncrossing price. Futures are marked to market daily; the near and next-near ALSI contracts are marked against quoted prices, the rest marked to model on the cost-of-carry formula.
JSE.not_free: JSE Equity/Currency/Interest-rate/Commodity derivatives EOD dissemination via IDP FTP, by subscription: mdproducts@jse.co.za / MDSalesTeam@jse.co.za. Fee paying; no free public derivatives feed was found.
